caption: The drawing consists of five rectangular shapes arranged in two rows, with three rectangles on the top row and two on the bottom row, all set against a plain, off-white background. Each rectangle contains a depiction of wood grain, shown in various stages of completion. The leftmost rectangle in the top row is sketched lightly in gray pencil, without any color fill, showing only the outline of the wood grain pattern. The middle and right rectangles in the top row add increasing amounts of brown and beige color, simulating the natural look of wood, with the grain pattern becoming more distinct and the color denser as it progresses from left to right. In the second (bottom) row, the two rectangles continue this progression, with deeper and richer brown tones filling more of the rectangle, while some areas at the bottom remain uncolored and display the penciled outline. The overall progression from top left to bottom right demonstrates a gradual coloring process, with the wood grain pattern becoming more defined and the color more saturated in each subsequent rectangle. The drawing is rendered in shades of brown, beige, and off-white, with visible brushstrokes and some areas left unpainted.
title: Technique Demo (Wood Grain)
